title: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Activity Goodwill on Mobile Wallet Shortfalls
content:
Cross-product benefit notice: customers who use **Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay** receive a goodwill amount when a **Mobile Wallet** credit arrives short.

**Top-Up goodwill.** The Top-Up goodwill on a shortfall make-good follows the customer's Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay orders with status delivered that were ordered in the last 12 calendar months:

| Delivered orders in the window | Top-Up goodwill (USD) |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 1.00 |
| at least 3 and fewer than 6 | 0.50 |
| fewer than 3 | nothing |

**The window.** It is rolling: it holds the orders whose order moment lies fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today, the whole calendar months from a date to today being the difference between the two calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is lower than that date's. Only orders whose status is delivered count.

## Hypothetical cases (today 2026-08-12)
- Orders placed 2025-08-13 and later, five delivered and one not delivered: 5 delivered orders, 0.50.
- An order placed 2025-08-12 gives 12 whole months and falls outside the window; one placed 2025-08-13 gives 11 and falls inside.
- Seven delivered airtime and bill orders inside the window: 1.00.
